name: Barbell Forward Lunge
steps: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and a barbell resting securely across your upper back.
Brace your core and step one foot forward into a long stride with your torso upright.
Bend both knees smoothly to lower your back knee toward the floor until your front thigh reaches roughly parallel.
Drive firmly through your front foot to return to standing, then step forward with the opposite leg, alternating sides.
tips: Keep your front knee tracking straight over your toes without caving inward.
Step wide enough from side to side for steady balance under the bar.
